title: localfix: hub requires frank_aad 0x0020 in the room's required safe_aad list
description: Per rohanmahy on mimi-protocol#166 (2026-10-19): 'if your implementation requires franking, then include 0x0020 as a required component'. mimid's hub requires a frank_aad item on every message (hub/submit.rs:94, :275-287; mandatory franking), but room creation (hub/room.rs) never checks that the GroupContext safe_aad list (mls-extensions-10 §5, required Safe AAD components) contains 0x0020, so a member that doesn't understand frank_aad can be in a room whose messages the hub then refuses. Fix: create_room refuses a group whose GroupContext safe_aad list lacks 0x0020; check commits that change it (GroupContextExtensions/AppDataUpdate of safe_aad) the same way; test fixtures that build groups with an empty list (e.g. mimi-mls tests Member::create(.., &[(SAFE_AAD, vec![0x00])])) are only affected where they go through the hub. Regression test first. Also give mimi-mls's group-creation helpers a way to set the required list including 0x0020 for the agent (.13).
